svg.title: One character in, a whole new digest
svg.desc: The results line COHNDNE999X000,50 and its SHA-256 digest. Below it, the same line with the mark changed to 51, and its digest, with the 62 characters that differ shaded. Only 2 of the 64 characters happen to match.
svg.text: ONE CHARACTER OF THE FILE CHANGED
Shaded: the 62 of 64 digest characters that changed. Only 2 happen to match.
There is no visible link between the two digests, and no clue to where the file changed.
